title: Zarr Convention Registry Entry
description: Schema for a registered Zarr convention entry

uuid.description: Permanent, immutable UUID identifier for this convention

name.description: Canonical short name of the convention

namespace.description: Namespace prefix used for convention attributes; must be lowercase and start with a letter, may end with a colon

title.description: Human-readable full title of the convention

description.description: Short description of what the convention encodes, one paragraph

spec_url.description: URL of the authoritative specification document

schema_url.description: URL of the JSON schema for this convention

maintainers.description: One or more maintainers: GitHub handles, names, organisation names, email addresses, or any combination

maturity.description: Maturity level using the zarr-conventions-spec tiers

doi.description: DOI of the archived stable specification, issuer at author's discretion; required at Stable maturity, otherwise null or omitted

composes.description: UUIDs of conventions composed by this convention

tags.description: Domain and topic tags for discovery, e.g. ['geospatial', 'coordinates', 'CF']

version.description: Current version string if the convention is versioned, null otherwise

version_history.description: UUIDs of prior versions of this convention, in reverse chronological order

implementations.description: Links to known implementations (other than conventions composing this convention)

registered.description: Date of registration in the registry, set by the registry CDG on merge

status_changed.description: Date of most recent maturity status change, updated by the registry CDG
